    • getDownloadFileInfo

      public org.apache.commons.lang3.tuple.ImmutableTriple<BufferedInputStream,String,jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType> getDownloadFileInfo(Long documentId) throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException
      Builds a well formatted response with a stream to the content and correct content headers
      Parameters:
      documentId - document id
      Returns:
      a triplet containing in order : a stream to the file (empty stream if no file), the file name in UTF-8 or an empty string if no file has been uploaded, the media type of the file or MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM if no file present
      Throws:
      javax.jcr.RepositoryException - in case of a JCR issue
